= Karpenter Provider Oxide
:description: Karpenter node provisioning for Oxide.
:p: oxide-karpenter
:anchor_prefix: k8s-api

[.lead]
Karpenter Provider Oxide launches Kubernetes nodes on an Oxide rack.

[id="oxide-node-class"]
== OxideNodeClass

Reference an `OxideNodeClass` from a Karpenter `NodePool`.

[source,yaml]
----
apiVersion: karpenter.oxide.computer/v1alpha1
kind: OxideNodeClass
metadata:
  name: default
spec:
  storage:
    boot:
      size: 20Gi
  kubeletArgs:
    - cloud-provider=external
  bootstrap:
    kubeadm: {}
  imageSelector:
    - id: IMAGE_ID
  subnetSelector:
    - vpcName: default
      project: my-project
----

[id="{anchor_prefix}-github-com-oxidecomputer-karpenter-provider-oxide-pkg-apis-v1alpha1-diskset"]
==== DiskSet



DiskSet is a group of identically configured disks attached to every launched instance.



.Appears In:
****
- xref:{anchor_prefix}-github-com-oxidecomputer-karpenter-provider-oxide-pkg-apis-v1alpha1-storage[$$Storage$$]
****

[cols="20a,50a,15a,15a", options="header"]
|===
| Field | Description | Default | Validation
| *`name`* __string__ | Name identifies the set. + |  | MaxLength: 20 +
MinLength: 3 +
Pattern: `^[a-z]([a-z0-9-]*[a-z0-9])?$` +

| *`type`* __string__ | Type selects Distributed or Local disks. + | Distributed | Enum: [Distributed Local] +

| *`count`* __integer__ | Count is how many disks the set has. + | 1 | Maximum: 7 +
Minimum: 1 +
Optional: \{} +

| *`size`* __link:https://kubernetes.io/docs/reference/generated/kubernetes-api/v1.36/#quantity-resource-api[$$Quantity$$]__ | Size is the capacity of each disk in the set, not of the set as a whole. + |  | Required: \{} +

| *`layout`* __string__ | Layout is how the set's disks are presented to the guest. + | Individual | Enum: [Individual] +
Optional: \{} +

| *`filesystem`* __string__ | Filesystem is what the guest formats each disk with. + |  | Enum: [ext4 xfs None] +
Optional: \{} +

| *`mountPath`* __string__ | MountPath is the single mount point for a set of one disk. + |  | MaxLength: 253 +
Pattern: `^/[^/]+(/[^/]+)*$` +
Optional: \{} +

| *`mountDir`* __string__ | MountDir is the parent directory the set's disks are placed beneath. + |  | MaxLength: 253 +
Pattern: `^/[^/]+(/[^/]+)*$` +
Optional: \{} +

| *`imageSelector`* __xref:{anchor_prefix}-github-com-oxidecomputer-karpenter-provider-oxide-pkg-apis-v1alpha1-imageselector[$$ImageSelector$$] array__ | ImageSelector selects the image each disk in the set is created from. + |  | Optional: \{} +

| *`snapshotSelector`* __xref:{anchor_prefix}-github-com-oxidecomputer-karpenter-provider-oxide-pkg-apis-v1alpha1-snapshotselector[$$SnapshotSelector$$] array__ | SnapshotSelector selects the snapshot each disk in the set is created from. + |  | Optional: \{} +

| *`readOnly`* __boolean__ | ReadOnly attaches sourced disks read-only. + |  | Optional: \{} +

|===
